notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Village Bell-Ringer, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Village Bell-Ringer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
